quotes.text: In plain English, shadow IT means using software or services at work without the IT department knowing about it. And it's more common than you think.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Clear plain-English definition of shadow IT.

quotes.text: Every unapproved app is a potential entry point for an attacker because you can't protect what you can't see.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Concise statement of the security risk behind unknown apps.

quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters

quotes.text: Don't block anything yet, don't sanction anything yet. Just look, you'll probably be surprised by what you find.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters

quotes.text: The biggest risk isn't the apps you know about. It's the ones you don't. Defender for Cloud Apps turns those blind spots into something you can actually see and manage.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Sums up the core value of the product.

chapters.title: What Defender for Cloud Apps is
Policies, threat detection and data protection

takeaways: Defender for Cloud Apps is a cloud access security broker that makes shadow IT visible by discovering every cloud app employees use.
The app catalog rates over 31,000 apps on security, compliance and legal factors so you can sanction, unsanction or monitor each one.
Start with visibility through Cloud Discovery, then add policies, enforcement and ongoing tuning in phases.
hook: Employees sign up for file-sharing sites and AI tools every day without telling IT, and that data leaves your control. This episode explains Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps in plain English for business and IT decision makers. You will learn how it discovers hidden apps, scores their risk and helps you protect your data step by step.
